patch_description: The current candidate (symmetric grouping + RX layer + ZZZ/CCRZ three-qubit gates) underperforms the original seed ansatz (0.58 vs 0.63 combined score), showing that added complexity (extra params, three-qubit gates, deeper circuit) hurt generalization rather than help it. Reverting to the original seed's proven CRZ-based structure and then applying the recommended enhancement — repeating the same 12 CRZ gates (reusing identical crz_0…crz_11 parameters) right after the first CRZ block — deepens two-qubit correlations without adding any new parameters. This tests whether intensifying entanglement (effectively squaring the two-qubit unitary per shared parameter) can boost expressivity/accuracy while keeping parameter count fixed at 162, potentially improving over the 0.63 baseline.
